correctness.rationale: The exact coordinate chart description is proved by displaying all edge monomial ratios and showing their full lattice relations are precisely the 2-by-2 minors of a 2-by-w Segre matrix, with the other variables freely independent. The minors define a normal CM rank-one cone, smooth away from the origin, singular only there for w>=2. These local charts cover Proj and identify all singular components. Dimension, degree, Hilbert series, multiplicity, class group and canonical criterion follow from standard Segre-cone invariants. 192 chart checks and exact determinant Jacobian/Hilbert checks substantiate independent finite instances; they are not infinite proofs. Limits: field characteristic zero, 3 nonempty parts, reduced singular locus only.

value.rationale: Complete tripartite edge toric varieties form a natural Segre–Veronese/graph-polytope family investigated since 2000. Their projective singular set is fully classified with at most three *disjoint* positive-dimensional Segre varieties despite arbitrarily high dimension; transverse multiplicities record the omitted part sizes and can differ, yielding non-equidimensional singular loci. These exact local structures identify non-Q-factorial and Q-Gorenstein boundaries, information not supplied by existing f-vectors or the global affine ring class group. This is a motivated infinite-family geometric classification rather than an arbitrary finite computation or renaming. The previously known Gorenstein numerical criterion is presented only as recovered context.
